stories.title: Stripe didn’t really buy OpenRouter because of the ‘singularity’
stories.simple_summary: Stripe, a company that helps businesses take payments online, bought OpenRouter (a tool that connects to different AI services). Stripe says it's about the future, but the real reason is more practical.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI seeks to one-up Anthropic with new customer privacy protections
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI and Anthropic (two AI companies) are competing to offer better privacy protection for business customer data. This means they're working on keeping customer information more private.
stories.why_it_matters: If your business uses their AI tools, this is good news because they're focusing on keeping your data safer.

stories.title: Cognition CEO denies report that SpaceX tried to acquire the startup
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX may or may not have tried to buy Cognition, an AI company that writes computer code. The CEO of Cognition says the report isn't accurate.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech enthusiasts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: AI was supposed to win people over by now — it hasn’t
stories.simple_summary: Even though AI is everywhere now, many people are becoming more cautious about using it instead of more excited. Tech companies expected people to embrace AI by now, but that hasn't happened.
stories.why_it_matters: This reflects real concerns people have about AI, so you're not alone if you're unsure about trusting it.

stories.title: Google packs Search and Gemini with new AI study tools
stories.simple_summary: Google added new AI study tools to its Google Search and Gemini assistant to help students learn better. Think of it like adding a tutor feature to Google.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren who study, they might find these tools helpful for homework and learning.

stories.title: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
stories.simple_summary: Google created a special section in Gemini just for students, with features like flashcards, quizzes, note-taking, and a place to organize research.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have grandchildren who study, this could be a useful free tool for them during school season.

stories.title: Researchers say OpenAI revoked their access to limited cyber program
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI stopped letting some cybersecurity researchers access special AI tools they were using to find security problems and report bugs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to cybersecurity experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Meet the startup helping Wall Street put a price on AI compute
stories.simple_summary: A startup is helping Wall Street figure out how much AI computing power costs. Right now, companies spend hundreds of billions on AI equipment, but there's no easy way to price it fairly.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and big companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI hit the brakes. Now what?
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI decided to slow down its AI development work for two weeks to focus on making their systems more secure and safer.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows a major AI company is being cautious about safety, which is a responsible approach to something powerful and new.

stories.title: Meta AI is getting a Mac app
stories.simple_summary: Meta (Facebook's parent company) created a new app for Mac computers with its AI chatbot, which can help you with tasks and answer questions about what's on your screen.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use a Mac computer, this is a free tool available to you, though it's optional to use.

stories.title: TerraPower’s nuclear reactor has a secret weapon for powering AI data centers
stories.simple_summary: TerraPower is building a nuclear power plant that has a special advantage for powering the huge computer servers that run AI programs.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to companies building AI data centers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Amazon makes its AI-powered Alexa+ free on Fire TV, no Prime required
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is making its upgraded AI Alexa assistant free on Fire TV devices for everyone, not just Prime members.
stories.why_it_matters: If you own a Fire TV device, you can now get a better AI assistant without paying extra or having a Prime subscription.
